chunks: Abu Baṣīr narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:
Whoever is in a place where he cannot reach the ground should gesture by indication, even if he is in an isolated land.

key_terms.إِيمَاءً: a gestural motion used in place of normal physical movements
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the ground or earth needed here for normal prayer posture
key_terms.فَلْيُومِ: then let him gesture or indicate in prayer
key_terms.مَوْضِعٍ: a place or location in which the person is situated

ai.seo_question: How should someone perform salat if they cannot reach the ground?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for salat in a situation where a person cannot access the ground. In such a case, the person performs the prayer by gesturing, showing the flexibility of the law in constrained circumstances.
